checks: Published factory registers the real keyed tab and renders with shared React 18.
Read failures retain the last snapshot and disable dispatch until a successful refresh.
A forged option cannot construct a target; two synchronous clicks dispatch one catalog target.
A real SPECFLOW_FAILURE never retries and stays locked through polling, panel remount and page reload until explicit refresh.
Reading/source views render safely, follow the DSH theme and accept through the strict owner-controlled API.
Code acceptance requires loaded diff, a passed precheck and the explicit review checkbox.
Clarification options are editable and save through the versioned draft API.
Requirement edits keep uploaded, pasted and repository documents, preserve drafts through polling/tab switches and use frozen revision IDs with explicit conflict resolution.
Artifact editing freezes the artifact revision, retains text on 409 conflicts and saves a fresh unreviewed candidate without accepting or reusing approval of the old revision.
English/Chinese switching preserves unsaved document text, persists the selection, leaves the host document unchanged, and fits a 420px panel.
Hidden sessions stop polling; plugin unload removes tab, slot, stylesheet and all timers.
